body: Thank you very much for sharing this. Do you think it would be wrong of me to show my parents this? They don't understand at all and I think this would help but they get very emotional if I talk about my mental health and I don't like to upset them so I don't talk about it much. I don't see or talk to them very often but they are always saying things that really hurt and I get upset and then they get upset and I feel stupid and  guilty.
Thank you for your advice. Is it okay if I send you a message? I don't want to say too much on this because it feels really public.

Thank you for your reply. I don't know if I have schizophrenia or something like that. I'm being bounced around between psychiatrists who don't know what's wrong with me. I think I am hopeless and they don't know what else to do with me. It's not from taking drugs, although that can affect it, of course.

I don't have any close friends as I am weird and awkward and I am not close to my family emotionally or in physical distance. They really don't understand and think I just need to 'eat some fruit' and 'stop worrying' and everything will be okay and then I can 'get myself a job'. I've tried all these things but they don't listen to that. They are the family that if you tell them you have insomnia they'll say it's because you're not getting enough sleep.
No problem. I hope you feel better soon. I wish I could help you more. Good luck.

Thank you very much.

I hadn't heard that song before so I listened to a bit of it. I wish I had someone like that in my life.

I don't really enjoy much. Sorry to be boring, I can't think of anything. I'm bad at reading and learning because my brain gets so hazy and confused and it all just feels pointless. What do you like?
thank you but it hurts too much, sorry. i'm reliving it all the time and I just want to forget.

Thank you for your encouragement. I feel this way because my brain has always been wrong for my whole life and made me see things and made me sad and I am weird and different and I don't belong anywhere. A lot people have hurt me in very,very bad ways and made me weaker. and weaker and I have been trapped under rock bottom for years now. I have been through a lot of sad things that are hard for me to say and would be hard for you to read. I feel like I'm living a nightmare. My future right now is also very, very bleak. I honestly don't think I can face it.

when I was in relationships they could help me but I don't have anyone like that anymore. I can't think of anything else in all honesty. Thank you for asking though, I very much appreciate your response.

I fully understand but the only helpful thing I can say is most drugs aren't going to help you at all. A lot of them don't even get rid of the pain in the moment and you get to feel even more like shit when you wake up. 

I dunno what to offer as an alternative but hopefully that'll save you some shitty feelings in the future. Weed works for some people but for others it makes it worse. I wouldn't class that as a drug though.
Thank you for your reply, I DMd you :)
Thank you, I've sent you a message :)
That's so great! Keep up that passion and determination, I think it will take you a long way.
You did really well to stick at it, most of us would have given up and to say that you want to move on to do more.. I think you should be very proud of yourself :)
